name: ac-sovereign-debt
description: Sovereign debt and its restructuring mechanics: the difference between a sovereign and a corporate credit, collective action and aggregation clauses, the restructuring process from exchange offer to IMF programme, currency mismatch and the local-versus-foreign law split, holdout creditors and their limits, recovery arithmetic and the exit yield, and the written sovereign record. It explains the legal and economic machinery of restructuring; it never recommends a bond and never predicts a default or a policy outcome. Use when asking "sovereign debt", "collective action clause", "CAC", "debt restructuring", "IMF programme", "Paris Club", "holdout creditor", "local law versus foreign law", "sovereign default", "recovery value". Not for reading macro releases and policy (ac-macro-and-policy-reading), not for corporate credit analysis (ac-bank-and-credit-analysis), not for FX risk in a portfolio (ac-currency-and-fx-risk).
